name: Process De-metaphorization and Formula Baiting
description: Restored the exact mechanical process to pass anchor tests, but replaced scheduling-like phrases ("entirely to the right of", "starts after ends") with geometric coordinate displacements (X_{k+1} - X_k >= d_1). Added the explicit max-sum formula as a true geometric property note. This acts as bait: models fail to recognize the flow-shop precedence without the scheduling metaphors, and instead try to directly optimize the provided minimax formula using flawed greedy logic.
